faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Shaghalni's automated job discovery service
faq.a1: Via Jawwal Pay — you pay the subscription, get confirmation, then the bot starts a chat to collect your data.
faq.q2: How often do I receive jobs?
faq.a2: Every 2 days (every 48 hours) you'll receive a fresh batch of jobs matching your profile throughout your subscription period.
faq.q3: Do I need to download an app?
faq.a3: No, Shaghalni works entirely inside WhatsApp and Telegram — no additional app needed.
faq.q4: What information is required from me?
faq.a4: Your CV (PDF), certificates if any, your skills, and preferences: preferred city, work type (full-time/part-time/remote), and expected salary (optional).
faq.a5: Yes, your data is encrypted and protected, never sold to third parties. You can request full deletion anytime via the bot.
faq.q6: How are the jobs sent to me selected?
faq.a6: Our system matches your skills, experience, and preferences against available jobs from multiple sources, sending you only the best matches.
faq.q7: What job types do you support?
faq.a7: We support most professional, technical, administrative, and service roles across experience levels, both in Palestine and remote.
faq.a8: You can message us via the contact page, directly from inside the bot chat, or via email.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.draftNotice: Note: This is a draft subject to legal review before official launch.
privacyPage.sec1Content: We collect information necessary to provide the service: the CV you share, your certificates, skills, job preferences (city, work type, expected salary), and your chat history with the bot.
privacyPage.sec2Content: We use your data to build your professional profile, match your skills with available job opportunities, and send you suitable jobs periodically.
privacyPage.sec3Content: We retain your files and chats throughout your active subscription, or until you request deletion. You can request wiping your records at any time.
privacyPage.sec4Content: We never sell or rent your personal data to third parties, nor do we use it for unauthorized advertising.
privacyPage.sec5Content: You have the right to request a copy of your data or its permanent deletion at any time by contacting us or sending a delete command in the chat.
privacyPage.sec6Content: We implement rigorous security standards including transport encryption and protected storage to ensure the confidentiality of your professional documents.
privacyPage.sec7Content: For any privacy-related inquiries or to exercise your rights, please contact our team via the designated privacy email.

termsPage.title: Terms of Service
termsPage.draftNotice: Note: This is a draft subject to legal review before official launch.
termsPage.sec1Content: Shaghalni is a smart platform for job discovery and delivery via WhatsApp and Telegram. The service operates on a monthly subscription via Jawwal Pay, and sends you jobs matching your profile every 2 days. Shaghalni does not guarantee employment and is not an official employment agency.
termsPage.sec2Content: Users are solely responsible for the accuracy of information in their CV, certificates, and preferences, and for reviewing jobs sent before applying.
termsPage.sec3Content: Using the service for fraudulent purposes, attempting to exploit the system, circumvent its mechanisms, or sharing others' accounts is strictly prohibited.
termsPage.sec4Content: The service is provided 'as is'. We are not liable for any employment decisions or losses resulting from applying to jobs sent via the platform.
